overview_description.description: Breez develops tools for detecting, investigating, and responding to identity threats within cloud environments. The company’s solutions support platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, as well as SaaS applications including Office 365, Google Workspace, and Workday. Its software automates incident response workflows and enables one-click investigations to assist security teams in managing identity-related risks. Founded by a former chief information security officer, it focuses on providing practical solutions to address challenges in cloud identity security and streamline threat mitigation.

identifier.value: Breez Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR)

product.name: Breez Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR)
product.description: A cloud-based platform that detects compromised human and non-human identities and automates incident response using behavioral analytics.

product.name: Behavioral Identity Fingerprint
product.description: A system that captures and tracks static and dynamic activity patterns of human and non-human identities in the cloud.

product.name: Usage-Based Entitlement Management
product.description: A tool that manages and creates permissions based on actual usage data to enforce least privilege access.

product.name: Continuous Attack Detection
product.description: A system that proactively detects attacks by monitoring changes in identity behavior in real-time.

product.name: Identity-Centric Investigation and Automated Workflows
product.description: Tools that use identity context to streamline incident investigation and automate response workflows.
